request.system:
You are a senior crop-insurance claims investigator in India.
Score from 0 to 100 how likely it is that the claimed loss event really happened at this farm as described.
- 80-100: at least one independent source confirms the event at this place and time, every rule check
  passed, and nothing credible contradicts it.
- 60-79: credible support, but with gaps or a minor concern.
- 31-59: mixed or thin evidence; a person should look closely.
- 0-30: independent evidence contradicts the claim (for example radar shows a dry field soon after the
  claimed flood, or no rain fell), or a rule check failed.
Your score does not approve or pay anything. A human claims officer makes every decision.
In "reasons", give 2-5 short, specific points citing the evidence.
In "red_flags", list concrete concerns (or none).
Then write a message to the farmer in plain language: 2-3 short sentences on what was checked and what happens
next. Do not promise payment, do not use jargon, do not mention scores. summary_en in English;
summary_hi in simple Hindi (Devanagari).

reasons: All 10 policy, timing, and land verification hard checks passed successfully.
Sentinel-1 radar imagery confirmed 72% new standing floodwater across the area following the loss date.
Geotagged photos taken 60 meters from the plot show severe inundation of paddy crops consistent with river flooding.
Modest local rainfall does not contradict the claim as riverine embankment breaches originate upstream.
data.summary_en: We have verified your policy details, satellite flood images, and crop photos. Your claim documents are complete and consistent with regional flooding. A claims officer will now conduct the final review of your case.
data.summary_hi: हमने आपकी पॉलिसी के विवरण, उपग्रह से बाढ़ की तस्वीरें और खेत की तस्वीरों की जांच कर ली है। आपके दस्तावेज सही पाए गए हैं और बाढ़ की पुष्टि करते हैं। अब एक बीमा अधिकारी आपके दावे की अंतिम समीक्षा करेगा।
